text: This report recommends approving an agreement with United Refrigeration for the non-exclusive supply and delivery of refrigeration parts and supplies for a one-year term with three (3) one-year options to renew. This recommendation follows the competitive Request for Quotation process undertaken by Exhibition Place considering six (6) companies that have experience providing these goods.

The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Approved an agreement with United Refrigeration for the non-exclusive supply and delivery of refrigeration parts and supplies for a one-year term commencing January 1, 2019 with three (3) one-year options to renew on the terms and conditions set out in the report (November 1, 2018) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place and such other terms and conditions required by the Chief Executive Officer and City Solicitor.
